question: I control one creature that attacks each turn if able and one creature with no abilities, and an effect says no more than one creature can attack each turn. Can I attack with just the other creature, with both, or with no creature at all?

expected.shortAnswer: No: the only legal attack is the creature that attacks if able attacking alone.
expected.answer: A player controls two creatures: one that “attacks if able” and one with no abilities. An effect states “No more than one creature can attack each turn.” The only legal attack is for just the creature that “attacks if able” to attack. It’s illegal to attack with the other creature, attack with both, or attack with neither.
